segment_summary: এই অসমাপ্ত স্বাদটি এক স্থির, কিন্তু তীব্র আকাঙ্ক্ষার প্রতীক, যা নিখুঁত সিঙ্গাড়াটির জন্য নিরন্তর অপেক্ষা করে চলেছে।

segment_enrichment.angle: Framing the search for flavor not as nostalgic yearning, but as a desperate cartographic attempt—mapping intangible terroir onto concrete foreign geography.
segment_enrichment.story_option: Setting: A high-speed journey past blurred industrial landscapes, Desire: To project the entire memory/taste onto the passing visual blur until the form breaks down into pure chromatic sensation., Obstacle: The relentless, indifferent speed of modern transit.
segment_enrichment.subject_rotation: Exploring the taste decay through an anthropological lens—how does 'exile-taste' become its own distinct culinary anthropology?
segment_enrichment.sensory_detail: The phantom warmth radiating from an empty vessel that was recently hot.
segment_enrichment.research_question: What are precise Bengali lexicon descriptors for 'lingering absence' when applied to a gustatory experience?
segment_enrichment.structural_variant: Employing an initial, very short burst of highly dense language (hyper-saturation) immediately followed by a long, sparse section dedicated only to silence/void.
segment_enrichment.variety_note: Unlike previous chapters which focused on the material transfer or geographical shift, this chapter zeroes in entirely on the internal, post-ingestion phenomenology—the residue within consciousness itself.
